title: Program checks

rows.message: O1234 G50: the program name has to stand in a block of its own
N100G00: the sequence name has to be followed by a space or a tab
G96 S180 M03 S200: 2 S words in one block
G97: the block has to write S
M110: has to stand in a block of its own; the block writes M08 besides it
T0101 T0202: 2 T words in one block
M3 M8 M10 M11 M12 M13 M14 M15 M16: 9 M codes in one block; the control takes at most 8
G140: the control refuses it while constant surface speed is on
T010202: a 6-digit tool word after 4-digit ones (line 6); one file should keep to one form
T12345: not a tool word this machine's tool-word format describes (5 digits)
